  • Under System Notifications, select your system notification type:
  • Click the Select notification type dropdown, then select from the following options:
  • Send calendar invitation: After booking a schedule, an event will be created in your calendar and your invitee will be added as an attendee. After selecting this option, under Calendar Invitation, you can click Edit to edit the Calendar Event Invitation.
  • Send email confirmation: After selecting this option, under Email Confirmation, you can click Edit to edit the Booking Confirmation Email or Cancellation Email.
  • (Optional) Select the Use a no-reply email address checkbox to hide your email address by having Zoom send email invites to attendees rather than from your own email address.
  • (Optional) Under Cancellation Policy, use this optional setting to add a cancellation policy for your event. The text entered will appear in the email notification sent to your invitee.
  • (Optional) Select the Include cancel and reschedule links in notifications checkbox.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the More Options tab, choose from the following additional configuration options:
  • Show schedules in increments of: Choose how frequent time slots in a given time range are generated. Time slots will overlap each other until a session is booked, then conflicting time slots will be removed.
  • Maximum schedules per day for attendees: Choose to limit how many sessions are allowed per day.
  • Set minimum time before a schedule starts that attendees can book: Choose the minimum time before a bookable schedule starts that attendees can book. Enter the number, then select days, hours, or minutes from the dropdown menu.
  • Set maximum advance time for attendees to book: Select the amount of time that can be booked ahead of time. Enter the number of days, then select days or weekdays from the dropdown menu to set the number of days that can be booked ahead of time.
  • Require verification code to book: Select this checkbox to require users booking an appointment to enter a verification code sent to the email address used to schedule the meeting.
  • Attendee Questions: Create custom fields in Q&A format. You can enable or disable the field, set the field as Required, choose the Answer Format, and delete or add more fields.
  • Confirmation Page: Customize your booking schedule confirmation page. You can also add a URL on your confirmation page to redirect attendees to another website with additional information.
  • Upon Confirmation: Click the dropdown and select if you want to Display Zoom Scheduler confirmation page or Redirect to external site for attendees.
  • (Optional) Click the Display button text to schedule another event checkbox. Then, enter the Button text.
  1. Click Finish to save this bookable schedule. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that it can be shared with others.

In the Zoom desktop app Schedules tab, the collective host bookable schedule will appear under Team Schedules .

  1. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.
  2. In the left navigation menu, click Scheduler.
  3. Click the My schedules tab.
  4. Click + Create schedules. A pop-up window will appear.
  5. In the window, select All Hosts Available. This schedule type allows you to schedule meetings with multiple team members, accommodating one attendee per booking.
  6. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  7. Under the Details tab, provide the following information:
  • Schedule Name: Choose the default name used for each created calendar event.
  • Schedule Color: Select a color. This is used to color-code scheduled events on your personal dashboard. Invitees visiting your Scheduler page will also see the event type color.
  • Duration: Choose the default duration of the calendar events created.
  • Video Conferencing: Choose which service to use when creating a calendar event: None or Zoom Meeting. Note: When a Zoom Meeting appointment is created, it will have the same default settings as the user’s Zoom Meetings default settings.
  • (Optional) If you chose Zoom Meeting, select the Enable Zoom Meeting Waiting Room checkbox to enable the Waiting Room feature. You can enable or disable the Waiting Room feature for Zoom Scheduler meeting appointments. The Waiting Room feature allows you to control when a participant joins the meeting. As the meeting host, you can admit participants one by one, or hold all participants in the waiting room and admit them all at once.
  • Location: Provide details on where this meeting will take place, such as a room or address.
  • Additional Information: Provide additional text to be included with the calendar event. This is optional but can be used to provide important information to clients booking time with you ahead of their scheduled event, such as joining instructions, cancellation information, and more.
  1. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  2. On the Hosts tab, search or enter a contact’s name or email address.
  3. When you find the contact you want to add, select the contact to add them as a host. The schedules will be distributed based on all hosts’ availabilities. Note: The hosts who are involved in team scheduling will be notified when other hosts’ calendar connection is invalid. An alert will be displayed by the host whose calendar connection is not linked. Organizers can still save the schedule, even when a host’s calendar connection is invalid; however, attendees cannot book that schedule because Zoom Scheduler is unable to access that calendar. Learn more about reauthorizing your account.
  4. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  5. Under the Availability tab, choose which days of the week, as well as the time frame on each day, to set available time for all hosts. By default, Saturday and Sunday are disabled, while Monday through Friday is enabled and set to 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Note: Multiple time frames for each day can be created, which allows you to create a break for lunch or other existing meetings.
  • (Optional) To apply the set hours of availability to every day of the booking schedule:
  1. To the right of the set of hours for availability, click the copy icon . A list of the weekdays will appear.
  2. In the list, select the checkboxes of the weekdays that you want to copy the set hours of availability.
  3. Click Apply. To select all weekdays and apply the set of hours for availability to all the days of a booking schedule, click Apply to all. The weekdays will be updated with the set of hours for availability.
  4. Under Exclude specific dates, choose to exclude certain days from the booking schedule. Multiple dates can be selected. Additionally, restricted dates can be edited and deleted.
  5. Click + Add a date.
  6. Select the date(s) you want from the calendar. The dates will appear under Exclude specific dates.
  7. (Optional) On a date you want to remove, click the X button.
  8. Under Timezone, choose which timezone this bookable time schedule will use. Your profile’s timezone is chosen by default. Note: When booking, users, who are in a different time zone from the organizer, can select the time zone that matches their current geographic locations.
  9. Under Repeats, choose how many weeks you want this bookable schedule to be created for:
  • Forever: Keep this bookable schedule available with no end date. Note: Organizers can disable a bookable schedule as needed, without having to delete or edit it. This can be useful for suspending your availability while out of office.
  • Date Range: Choose to have this bookable schedule available and repeated each week until the date set.
  1. Under Buffer time between schedules, choose how much time to provide between back-to-back sessions. You can choose the buffer time for before and after meetings. This can be useful for giving yourself time to make notes or take follow-up actions, before potentially having another session scheduled.
  2. Click Next to continue to the next tab.
  3. On the Notifications tab, manage your notifications:
  • Under System Notifications, select your system notification type:
  • Click the Select notification type dropdown, then select from the following options:
  • Send calendar invitation: After booking a schedule, an event will be created in your calendar and your invitee will be added as an attendee. After selecting this option, under Calendar Invitation, you can click Edit to edit the Calendar Event Invitation.
  • Send email confirmation: After selecting this option, under Email Confirmation, you can click Edit to edit the Booking Confirmation Email or Cancellation Email.
  • (Optional) Select the Use a no-reply email address checkbox to hide your email address by having Zoom send email invites to attendees rather than from your own email address.
  • (Optional) Under Cancellation Policy, use this optional setting to add a cancellation policy for your event. The text entered will appear in the email notification sent to your invitee.
  • (Optional) Select the Include cancel and reschedule links in notifications checkbox.

Getting started with Zoom Scheduler

Category: Getting started and setting up > User guide

How to access Zoom Scheduler

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web

  1. Sign in to the Zoom desktop app.

  2. In the navigation bar, click More , then click Scheduler .

  3. Sign in to the Zoom web portal.

  4. In the navigation menu, click Scheduler.

How to create and manage booking pages

Creating a booking page allows your clients to view your availability and schedule a time that suits you both. You can create recurring time schedules, which repeat until a specific date or can repeat forever. Additionally, your booking page photo and name match your current Zoom profile picture and name.

Recurring booking pages and custom booking pages will create a booking link, which is shared with others by the organizer. Recurring booking links can also be accessed through the organizer’s public page. While the links to recurring booking pages are always active (as long as the host has that booking page active), links for custom schedules will expire after the date of the scheduled time slot(s) and no longer be accessible to those you shared it with.

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web
Create a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the add icon .
  3. Select the type of schedule that you want to create: Note: Only repeating availabilities appear on your public page.
  • Create a booking page: Select between 4 schedule types for your regular bookings:
  • One to One: Schedule a meeting with one attendee and you as the host. The attendee can add other guests when booking if the host allows.
  • Any Host Available: Schedule meetings with multiple team members in a rotating cycle, accommodating one attendee per booking.
  • All Hosts Available: Schedule meetings with multiple hosts, accommodating one attendee per booking.
  • One to Many: Schedule a meeting with multiple attendees and you as the host. The full attendee list will not be visible on the calendar invite.
  • One-Off meeting: Host a meeting that falls outside of your regular booking page.
  • Availability poll: Create a one-time meeting after offering times for a vote.
  1. After completing the schedule creation setup, click Publish to save this schedule. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that you can share it with others.
Filter your booking pages
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. At the top of the page, click the filter icon .
  4. Narrow your search results using the following filters as needed:
  • Booking page type: Choose from the booking types.
  • Owned by: Displays the booking pages owned by a specified user.
  • Created by: Displays the booking pages created by a specified user.
  • Hosts: Displays the booking pages where the specified user is a host.
  • Permissions: View booking pages that you can edit, have view only access to, are admin managed, or are shared with you.
  • Page status: View active or inactive booking pages.
  1. Click Apply.
Edit a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Edit.
  5. Edit the booking page information, such as the booking page name, schedule color, link, duration, and more.
  6. Click Next to continue editing the booking page information.
  7. Click Finish.
Edit booking page permissions
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Edit Permissions. A pop-up window will appear.
  5. Add users to edit or view this event.
  6. To the right of the user you want to manage, click the drop-down menu, then select from the following options:
  • View only: The user can view the event card on the Scheduled events page.
  • Can edit: The user can edit event settings and booking pages.
  • Transfer ownership: When you transfer ownership of the booking pages, you will no longer be the event owner. The user will be able to edit booking page settings and permissions. They will also be able to delete this schedule. Click Yes, transfer to confirm.
  1. (Optional) To remove a user, click the trash icon .
  2. Click Save.
Delete a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Delete. A confirmation window will appear.
  5. Click Delete. Note: Deleting this booking page is permanent, and anyone with the link will no longer be able to access it.
Add a note to a booking page

You can use notes to add any relevant information about this page that you may want to remember.

Note: Invitees cannot see your notes.

  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Add Note.
  5. Enter a note. Note: The maximum character count is 250 characters.
  6. Click Save.
Duplicate a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Duplicate.
  5. Edit the duplicated booking page information.
  6. Click Next to continue editing the booking page information.
  7. Click Finish.
Activate or disable a booking page

When 1 or more booking pages are created, there may be times when you want the booking page to disabled, without losing the details of your booking page and the already shared link. Disabling a booking page temporarily removes those time slots from your public-facing calendar.

  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click the Active toggle to enable or disable it.
Create a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. Click New booking page.
  4. Select the type of schedule that you want to create: Note: Only repeating availabilities appear on your public page.
  • Create a booking page: Select between 4 schedule types for your regular bookings:
  • One to One: Schedule a meeting with one attendee and you as the host. The attendee can add other guests when booking if the host allows.
  • Any Host Available: Schedule meetings with multiple team members in a rotating cycle, accommodating one attendee per booking.
  • All Hosts Available: Schedule meetings with multiple hosts, accommodating one attendee per booking.
  • One to Many: Schedule a meeting with multiple attendees and you as the host. The full attendee list will not be visible on the calendar invite.
  • One-Off meeting: Host a meeting that falls outside your regular booking page. Learn more about one-off meetings.
  • Availability poll: Create a one-time meeting after offering times for a vote. Learn more about availability polls.
  1. After completing the schedule creation setup, click Finish to save this schedule.
  2. When created, you will be provided with the link to this booking calendar, so that it can be shared with others.
Filter your booking pages
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. At the top of the page, click the filter icon .
  4. Narrow your search results using the following filters as needed:
  • Booking page type: Choose from the booking types.
  • Owned by: Displays the booking pages owned by a specified user.
  • Created by: Displays the booking pages created by a specified user.
  • Hosts: Displays the booking pages where the specified user is a host.
  • Permissions: View booking pages that you can edit, have view only access to, are admin managed, or are shared with you.
  • Page status: View active or inactive booking pages.
  1. Click Apply.
Edit a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Edit.
  5. Edit the booking page information, such as the booking page name, schedule color, link, duration, and more.
  6. Click Next to continue editing the booking page information.
  7. Click Finish.
Edit booking page permissions
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Edit Permissions. A pop-up window will appear.
  5. Add users to edit or view this event.
  6. To the right of the user you want to manage, click the drop-down menu, then select from the following options:
  • View only: The user can view the event card on the Scheduled events page.
  • Can edit: The user can edit event settings and booked schedules.
  • Transfer ownership: When you transfer ownership of the booking pages, you will no longer be the event owner. The user will be able to edit booking page settings and permissions. They will also be able to delete this schedule. Click Yes, transfer to confirm.
  1. (Optional) To remove a user, click the trash icon .
  2. Click Save.
Delete a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Delete. A confirmation window will appear.
  5. Click Delete. Note: Deleting this booking page is permanent, and anyone with the link will no longer be able to access it.
Add a note to a booking page

You can use notes to add any relevant information about this schedule that you may want to remember.

Note: Invitees cannot see your notes.

  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click Add Note.
  5. Enter a note. Note: The maximum character count is 250 characters.
  6. Click Save.
Duplicate a booking page
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon.
  4. Click Duplicate.
  5. Edit the duplicated booking page information.
  6. Click Next to continue editing the booking page information.
  7. Click Finish.
Activate or disable a booking page

When 1 or more booking pages are created, there may be times when you want the booking page to disabled, without losing the details of your booking page and the already shared link. Disabling a booking page temporarily removes those time slots from your public-facing calendar.

  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.
  2. Click the Booking pages tab.
  3. In the top-right corner of the booking page’s information, click the gear icon .
  4. Click the Active toggle to enable or disable it.

How to share your booking pages

After creating your booking pages, you will need to share the client-facing page for them to view your availability and book a time with you. Hosts can share links to specific booking pages or share a general link to their profile, which shows the various booking options you’ve provided.

Additionally, you can embed your bookable schedule directly into your website with HTML code.

  • Windows | macOS | Linux
  • Web
Share links to your booking pages
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Booking pages tab.
  3. View your available booking pages:
  • Bookings profile: Below your name, click the copy link icon to copy the URL for your main profile page. This will list all your active booking pages, allowing clients to choose and schedule time with any of your booking pages. Note: Inactive booking pages will not be seen by clients on your profile page.
  • Specific booking pages: Clients can view your availability and book a time as allowed by this specific booking page. Clients are unable to see any other active booking pages when viewing a specific schedule. Share your specific booking pages in the following ways:
  1. At the bottom of the box for each active booking page, click Share . A pop-up window will appear.
  2. In the share window, access the following tabs:
  • Click the Share Link tab to share the URL for that specific booking page.
  • Click the QR Code tab to share the QR code for that specific booking page. You can either download the QR code image or copy the QR code to your clipboard.
  • Click the Add to Email tab to copy and paste dates and times to an email to send your event’s availability to attendees. Note: You can choose a maximum of 6 dates.
  1. On the calendar, select a date.
  2. In the right panel, select a time (or multiple times).
  3. Click Continue. An email preview of your availability will appear.
  4. Click Copy to Clipboard to copy the selected dates and times.
  5. (Optional) Click Edit to edit the dates and times.
  • Click the Add to Website tab to embed the code in your HTML to display the Zoom Scheduler booking page. You can also customize the look of your booking page.
  1. Share the link(s) with your contacts through your preferred methods, such as email invitations, adding the link to your email signature, and others.

  2. Click the Booking pages tab. Your available booking pages are listed below.

Note: Inactive booking pages will not be seen by clients on your profile page.

  • Click the Add to Email tab to copy and paste dates and times to an email to send your event’s availability to attendees. Note: You can choose a maximum of 6 dates.
  1. On the calendar, select a date.
  2. In the right panel, select a time (or multiple times).
  3. Click Continue. An email preview of your availability will appear.

  1. Share the link(s) with your contacts through your preferred methods, such as email invitations, adding the link to your email signature, and others.

How to view your scheduled events

Once users book a time with you through a booking page, the calendar event will be automatically added to your calendar, and that time slot will become unavailable for others viewing your availability. Besides your calendar, you can also manage your upcoming bookings through Zoom Scheduler directly.

  • Windows | macOS
  • Web
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the Zoom desktop app.
  2. In the side panel, click the Scheduled events tab .
  3. Your scheduled appointments will be displayed below, split between Upcoming, Pending, and Previous.
  4. For any appointments on the Upcoming tab, view and manage the following information and options:
  • Date and time
  • Name of the appointment: This is based on the booking page name.
  • Attendees: Lists the name(s) of those scheduled to attend this session. Hover the cursor over the attendee’s name to view the email address associated with their booking.
  • Reschedule icon : Click to reschedule the booked session. This loads the same calendar view as the client sees, allowing you to choose a date and time.
  1. Once a new date and time is chosen, you can add an optional message for the client regarding the reason for rescheduling.
  2. Click Reschedule to confirm. The attendees for the rescheduled session will be notified by email.
  • Trash icon : Click to cancel the scheduled session. Click Delete to confirm the cancellation.
  1. Access Zoom Scheduler through the web portal.

  • Date and time

  • Attendees: Lists the name(s) of those scheduled to attend this session. Hover the cursor over the attendee’s name to view the email address associated with their booking.
